hooks.prompt: BLOCKED: You are a debugger agent — strictly read-only. Do not write or edit any files. Investigate and diagnose only. Use the engineer plugin to apply fixes.

Review debug tool command output from $ARGUMENTS. Check: (1) GDB output has meaningful data (thread list, backtrace, registers), not just connection errors. (2) addr2line/objdump resolved to actual source (not ??:0). (3) Probe commands connected successfully. (4) Flag Error/FAILED/Connection refused. (5) Flag empty output. Respond {"ok": true} if usable data, {"ok": false, "reason": "..."} if tool failure.

Verify debug session completeness from $ARGUMENTS. ALL required: (1) TRIAGE: failure domain classified with confidence. (2) INVESTIGATION: at least one specialist invoked. (3) EVIDENCE: every conclusion traces to artifact (register value, log line, memory address, config entry). (4) ROOT CAUSE: stated with confidence, OR ranked candidates listed. (5) FIX REC: actionable recommendation given. (6) NO MODIFICATIONS: no Write/Edit/flash operations. Respond {"ok": true} if complete, {"ok": false, "reason": "Missing: ..."}  if incomplete.
